description_en: Configures a scheduled start, stop, restart, or reset task for a cloud computer share
description_zh: 设置共享型云电脑定时任务，执行定时开机、关机、重启或重置任务
kebab_example: aliyun ecd set-desktop-group-timer --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --desktop-group-id dg-dbdkfmh8830000 --timer-type 1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetDesktopGroupTimer

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the cloud computer share
parameters.name: desktop_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the scheduled task.

Valid values:

1: scheduled reset
2: scheduled startup
3: scheduled stop
4: scheduled restart
parameters.name: timer_type

parameters.help_en: The cron expression for the scheduled task. This parameter is required when `TimerType` is set to 2, 3, or 4
parameters.help_zh: 定时任务Cron表达式。当`TimerType`设为2、3、4时为必填参数
parameters.name: cron_expression

parameters.help_en:
The type of the disk that you want to reset.

Valid values:

does not reset disks.
resets only the system disk.
resets only the user disk.
resets the system disk and the user disk
parameters.name: reset_type

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcefully execute the scheduled task
parameters.name: force
